lines.en: The march began at noon that day.
The army included some two hundred elite incarnations. As countless constellations watched, Lee Hyunsung raised a horn at the head of the army.
Bwoooooo.
[The item ‘Battlefield Horn’ activates!]
[Allied morale increases greatly!]
[Allied combat power increases slightly!]
Just as I’d expect of Han Sooyoung. It seemed she had already prepared consumables like that, too.
When Lee Hyunsung sounded the horn once more, the incarnations cheered.
Everyone seemed somewhat excited.
Beside me, Shin Yoosung had been stealing glances at my face. She spoke politely.
“Um…… Thank you for saving me last time.”
“Oh, yes. It was nothing.”
Shin Yoosung, smiling shyly at my reply.
Whoever had raised her, she certainly wasn’t an ill-mannered brat like Kim Namwoon.
I glanced to the side and saw Han Sooyoung wearing an unreadable smile.
……It probably wasn’t because of who raised her that Shin Yoosung had turned out this way.
Yoosung was a good kid to begin with.
“Are you participating in this scenario too, Kim Dokja-ssi?”
“No. I don’t meet the requirements.”
“Oh, I see…… That must be disappointing. I heard you can get a ‘Giant Story’ if you clear this scenario.”
I supposed it was disappointing, in a way.

Acquiring ‘Liberator of the Apocalypse Dragon’ here as Development (承), my second Giant Story, would certainly be something. But that wasn’t the direction I wanted to take. The Giant Story I wanted for Development was in the 3rd round.
Up ahead, I saw Lee Seolhwa wiping the sweat from Lee Hyunsung’s forehead. Lee Hyunsung spoke with a weak smile.
“……I’m nervous. I wonder if I can do this well.”
“You’ll be fine. You’ve done well so far.”
I could also hear the voices of Kim Namwoon and Lee Jihye, who were walking behind us.
“Hey, Lee Jihye. What are you doing after this scenario?”
“What else? Clearing another scenario.”
“How long are you going to do nothing but clear scenarios? You should have some fun once in a while. Come on, when this scenario’s over, you and I could……”

Wearing the coat I had lent him, Kim Namwoon was watching Lee Jihye’s reactions. He had put gloves on both hands, just as I’d told him. His hair was still white, and he still had bandages wrapped around his forearm, but……
Thunder crashed down from the sky with a rumble.
In the distance, I could see the legions of the nebulas participating in this scenario sweeping toward us.
Some belonged to nebulas I had already encountered, and others did not.
Han Sooyoung’s companions were certainly strong, but they lacked the numbers to face all of them.
Han Sooyoung stepped up onto Lee Hyunsung’s shoulders and spoke.
“We have just one objective. To free the ‘Apocalypse Dragon’ from that sealing sphere up there.”
Her snow-white coat fluttering, Han Sooyoung continued dispassionately.
“As you all know, freeing the ‘Apocalypse Dragon’ will destroy the Korean Peninsula. But once we fulfill the clear conditions, we can move on to the next stage. So no one on this land will die.”
The incarnations, who had stiffened, cheered again at Han Sooyoung’s declaration.
Some were chanting her name.
Something about the sight was familiar.
……These were all things Yoo Joonghyuk had once done.
Scenario 95, ‘Second Coming of the Apocalypse Dragon.’

This scenario involved awakening the ‘Apocalypse Dragon,’ which had been sealed during the fall of <Eden>. A scenario completed by gathering five ‘renowned swords’ scattered across the Earth and inserting them into the keyholes of that sealing sphere.
In fact, Yoo Joonghyuk had completed this scenario and acquired ‘Conclusion’ for his Giant Story.
“Onward, to the next scenario!”
At Han Sooyoung’s cry, the incarnation legion advanced toward the sealing sphere.
But there were others charging toward us from the opposite side.
[Take the swords! We must claim the keys!]
[Over there! It’s Han Sooyoung!]
They were constellations and incarnations who had been hiding throughout the Korean Peninsula. Those seeking to acquire a Story by contributing to the Apocalypse Dragon’s awakening.
“Stop them!”
The companions beside me scattered, drawing their weapons. Lee Hyunsung, Shin Yoosung, and Lee Jihye charged forward, unleashing their accumulated magic power.
“Hahahahaha! Come forth! Abyss Dragon!”
Kim Namwoon, too, was rampaging across the battlefield. Blackening (黑化), taken to its utmost limit.
The Kim Namwoon of this world was different from the Kim Namwoon I knew. But as he tore every living thing that approached him to shreds, he was unmistakably the Delusion Demon I knew.
I didn’t know all the terrible things he had done to get this far.
Rrrrrumble!
And amid it all, Han Sooyoung was drawing swords from inside her coat, one by one.
Whiiiiine……
Star Relics rising into the air, shedding brilliant light. They were all ‘keys’ that would be used to clear this scenario.
Four swords in all.
She was still one sword short of a complete set of keys.
“Kim Dokja. Hand over your ‘Arondight.’”
“……You knew?”
I grinned and reached inside my coat.
The Dragon-Slaying Sword Arondight. It was this scenario’s final key.
“And send Yoo Joonghyuk to the sealing sphere.”
At Han Sooyoung’s next words, I stopped rummaging inside my coat and glared at her. Han Sooyoung was smiling.
“We agreed to kill him, didn’t we? Have you forgotten?”
A look that said, Aren’t you just like me?
At that moment, I realized something.
“Killing Yoo Joonghyuk was the condition of your ‘Otherworld Pledge,’ too.”
A strange light flashed in Han Sooyoung’s eyes.
“That’s right.”
“Is that why you were so fixated on Yoo Joonghyuk?”
“Just hurry up and hand over the sword.”
I felt the cold surface of Arondight inside my coat.
In truth, I knew very well what Han Sooyoung was going to do.
“The Holy Sword Ascalon. The Thunder Sword Gram. The Dragon-Cleaving Sword Ridill. The Dragon-Fighting Sword Naegling, and the Dragon-Slaying Sword Arondight.”
As I recited the swords’ names, Han Sooyoung’s expression stiffened oddly.
“Here’s a question. Of the swords I just named, choose the one that’s different from the others.”
“What are you trying to do?”
“You’re deceiving everyone.”
“Don’t talk nonsense.”
“‘Onward, to the next scenario’?”
I continued.
“Don’t play dumb. You have no intention of clearing this scenario.”
Han Sooyoung’s pupils trembled faintly. A smile bordering on madness entered her eyes, which had looked bored throughout.
The four renowned swords shone white beside her.
“Go on.”
“You don’t intend to free the Apocalypse Dragon. Quite the opposite. You intend to seal this ‘Earth’ along with it.”
“What makes you think that?”
I pointed to the sword in Han Sooyoung’s right hand.
“That Dragon-Fighting Sword Naegling you’re holding. It’s the only one of your ‘swords’ with a different property.”
The five swords that made up Scenario 95 all possessed Stories related to dragon slaying (龍殺).
But just one, the ‘Dragon-Fighting Sword Naegling,’ did not.
“That sword failed to slay a dragon. Using it as a key won’t break the seal. It’ll do the opposite.”
An unsuitable key would strengthen the seal instead of breaking it.
Recognizing that the time of release had not yet come, the sealing sphere would form an even larger and stronger barrier, eventually covering the entire Earth in its seal.
“Time will stop here, and the Earth will be sealed along with the Apocalypse Dragon. Fixed forever in Scenario 95.”
Han Sooyoung had lowered her head, and I couldn’t read her expression. I continued.
“And that’s how you intend to kill Yoo Joonghyuk.”
I turned to look at Yoo Joonghyuk.
Yoo Joonghyuk, looking at me with empty eyes.
As long as he had his sponsor, Yoo Joonghyuk would not die.
Even if he died, he would simply regress again and again.
But……
What if eternal sleep existed in this world?
An eternal sleep without dreams, from which he could not be awakened.
If such a thing existed, how would it differ from ‘death’?
“You decided to seal Yoo Joonghyuk in this round forever.”
Trapped in the sealing sphere, Yoo Joonghyuk would fall into a sleep from which no one could wake him.
He would not regress, nor would he suffer anymore.
He would simply sleep forever, and no new worldlines would be created because of him.
That was the ‘death’ of Yoo Joonghyuk that Han Sooyoung had spoken of.
The death of a regressor who had transcended time.
When I turned my head, Han Sooyoung was smiling faintly.
“Not bad. How did you figure it out? I never showed you exactly what I planned to do next.”
“I figured it out because you didn’t show me.”
I had looked inside Han Sooyoung’s mind.
I had seen the world she dreamed of and read the information she showed me.
It was certainly a story in which almost everything was perfect.
But that world lacked one crucial thing.
“I couldn’t see ■■ in your story.”
The end of all these scenarios, ■■.
But not everyone reached ■■.
Some Stories ended without ever getting anywhere near ■■.
Thunder sounded in the western sky.

Dark clouds gathered, and rain began to fall. In the distance, our companions’ shouts rang out, along with the True Voices of constellations locked in desperate combat. Lee Hyunsung, Lee Seolhwa, Lee Jihye. They were all fighting desperately.
To survive.
To survive once more and reach the next scenario.
It was Han Sooyoung who had brought them this far.
“Is this the conclusion ten thousand of you came up with?”
And now, Han Sooyoung was trying to end their story.
“Yes. This is the end I envisioned for this world.”
“If you were going to end it this way anyway, why go out of your way to keep all your companions alive? Why insist on such a perfect course of events?”
Han Sooyoung did not answer.
“You’ve betrayed them.”
If Han Sooyoung’s plan succeeded, no one in this round would ever reach the last act.
They would fall asleep in the eternity of Scenario 95.
With expressionless eyes, Han Sooyoung looked at the four swords floating around her.
“A world’s end doesn’t have to be ■■. This will make the Earth safe. Neither Yoo Joonghyuk nor the other constellations know how to break the Apocalypse Dragon’s reinforced seal.”
“That’s deception.”
“Some forms of salvation are called that.”
“Then what about the companions who’ve trusted you all this time—”
“It’s not a world I created anyway.”
The miserable truth was that I understood how Han Sooyoung felt.
The reason I wanted to return to my original world was that this world wasn’t mine.
“Is that the reward you’re supposed to receive for the ‘Otherworld Pledge’? In exchange for killing Yoo Joonghyuk, you’ll gain the power to create your own world?”
Rrrrrumble!
Powerful currents of energy began to flow from Han Sooyoung’s body.
A sign that she would waste no more time.
“Hand over the sword, Kim Dokja. It’s what’s best for everyone. Yoo Joonghyuk wanted it, too.”
The plagiarist who wanted to surpass the original had probably known.
That to surpass the original, she had to break free of it.
And that as long as she remained a plagiarist, that was impossible.
I smiled.
“I have no intention of killing Yoo Joonghyuk.”
“What nonsense is that? Don’t tell me you’re giving up on the ‘Otherworld Pledge’?”
“Of course I’m not doing that, either.”
No sooner had I finished speaking than Han Sooyoung vanished.
“Yoo Joonghyuk, stop her!”
At my shout, Yoo Joonghyuk stepped forward and blocked Han Sooyoung’s incoming swords. I put Arondight back inside my coat and drew another sword at the same time.
It was the [Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword].
An item that severed the link between a constellation and an incarnation.
Looking at Yoo Joonghyuk, I concentrated my power into the sword.
Tzzzzzt……
[The Star Relic ‘Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword’ unleashes its power!]
Han Sooyoung’s eyes widened when she saw the energy gathering in the sword.
“Don’t tell me you’re……”
Death held many meanings in this <Star Stream>.
It had been the same when I fell victim to [Fate].
“It’s no use, Kim Dokja! That method……!”
Back then, I had died as ‘the incarnation Kim Dokja,’ but survived as ‘the constellation Kim Dokja.’
Then what about Yoo Joonghyuk?
“Gabriel, Jophiel! Please help me!”
[The constellation ‘Lily Blooming in Aquarius’ looks at you.]
[The constellation ‘Commander of the Red Cosmos’ looks at you.]
I heard Han Sooyoung shouting.
But I did not listen.
All my senses were focused on a single black thread extending above Yoo Joonghyuk’s head. It was his link, made visible by the power of the Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword.
No one in ‘Ways of Survival’ had ever attempted this method before.
But if it succeeded.
If I could sever this link, even for a moment, I might be able to save Yoo Joonghyuk.
“Yoo Joonghyuk, hold yourself together!”
Yoo Joonghyuk now possessed enough Stories to become a ‘constellation.’
If he acquired a new Story through this scenario while his connection to his sponsor was temporarily severed…… he might be reborn as ‘the constellation Yoo Joonghyuk.’
That would mean his death as an ‘incarnation.’
With this method, Yoo Joonghyuk might not have to regress even if he died.
I might be able to return to the 3rd round without sealing him away.
Rooooooar!
The Demon King’s Status and the archangel’s Status I had unleashed flowed into the Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword at the same time.
My opponent was Yoo Joonghyuk’s unidentified constellation.
Severing that link would require at least this much power.
I brought the Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword down.
Claaaaaang!
Once more.
Claaaang!
And once more.
Over and over, over and over, I struck.
The tremendous shock waves erupting from the link threatened to sweep away the nearby constellations and incarnations. A backlash so powerful that even Han Sooyoung couldn’t approach easily.
How many more times did I strike like that?
At last, I heard a crack.
The [Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword] in my hand snapped in two.
I stared at Yoo Joonghyuk’s link. It didn’t have so much as a scratch.
[The constellation ‘Lily Blooming in Aquarius’ feels an inexplicable terror.]
[The constellation ‘Commander of the Red Cosmos’ is aghast.]
For a moment, I felt as if the distant cosmos were looking at me.
It was a will whose origins I could not guess, so immense I could not even begin to fathom it.
[The sponsor of the incarnation ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ looks at you.]
Seized by intense vertigo, for an instant I felt as though the entire history of my life were warping.
Yoo Joonghyuk’s sponsor. I couldn’t tell exactly what it was. I could neither describe nor explain it. All I could grasp was this
Immensely powerful and pure.
Something like desire in its primal form had been there.
Something like a baby’s laughter echoed in my ears. When I came to my senses again, the broken halves of the Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword lay on the ground.
Yoo Joonghyuk’s link had not been severed. I had failed.
When I raised my head, Han Sooyoung was approaching me.
“You saw it too, didn’t you?”
Han Sooyoung, wearing a strange smile.
A [Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword] identical to mine swung at her waist.
“……You already tried it, too?”
“Of course. I tried it on a much greater scale than you did. I borrowed a nebula’s power to strike it.”
Perhaps Han Sooyoung had seen the sponsor’s true nature more clearly than I had.
“What the hell was that?”
“Who knows? I don’t know exactly. But doesn’t it give you some idea?”
I did not answer. Han Sooyoung continued.
“Now that your last plan’s failed, you must understand. There’s no way.”
“Like I said, Yoo Joonghyuk agreed to this plan, too.”
“Yoo Joonghyuk agreed?”
“You can read minds, can’t you? Didn’t you read his thoughts, too?”
With a clang, Yoo Joonghyuk knocked Han Sooyoung’s sword aside.
I looked at Yoo Joonghyuk’s back as he stood in front of me. Surely I could use Stage 2 of ‘Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint’ on him now, too. After a moment’s hesitation, I activated the skill.
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint’!]
[Your understanding of this person is sufficient. Activating ‘Stage 2’ of Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint!]
Then I could hear what was inside Yoo Joonghyuk’s mind. His consciousness had sunk so deep that most of the words drifted through the air like dust.
The words fell beside me like snow, one by one, then began pouring down like a blizzard.
「I want to die.」
「I want to die.」
「I want to die.」
What I was seeing now was a human being’s inner life, suppressed within the text of ‘Ways of Survival.’
As I stood there in a daze, Han Sooyoung strode up to me.
Her hair brushed the tip of my chin, and a hand darted inside my coat and took ‘Arondight.’
Having finally gathered all five swords, Han Sooyoung gave a small laugh and walked away from me, step by step.
Yoo Joonghyuk stood staring blankly at me.
Once Han Sooyoung inserted all those swords, Yoo Joonghyuk would be trapped in this round forever.
And he would attain the eternal rest he had wanted so desperately.
This was the ending that suited this world.
It was then that I heard some words.
It was a very small voice. A very faint voice among the countless voices pouring down.
After putting the broken Four Tiger Evil Cutting Sword inside my coat, I ran after Han Sooyoung. As my tight grip crumpled the shoulder of her coat, she frowned and turned her head.
“……Still being stubborn?”
I looked at Yoo Joonghyuk.
I had definitely heard it.
I could still hear it.
「I want to live.」
That one voice, so faint, so very faint.
It was unmistakably speaking there.
Han Sooyoung shook off my hand in irritation.
“Let go while I’m still asking nicely. If we’re going to get what we want, we have to kill Yoo Joonghyuk.”
“You don’t know what I want.”
I gripped ‘Unbreakable Faith.’
As the blade let out a shrill whine, Han Sooyoung’s expression hardened, and she stepped away from me.
“What the hell are you planning? You have no way to do it anyway.”
She was right. There was no way.
I had no way to save Yoo Joonghyuk while fulfilling the Otherworld Pledge.
There had been no such method anywhere in ‘Ways of Survival,’ which I had read all night.
“There is a way.”
But there was another way.
“Yoo Joonghyuk!”
At my shout, Yoo Joonghyuk rushed in like lightning and struck Han Sooyoung. In that brief opening, he seized four of the swords she held.
The Holy Sword Ascalon.
The Thunder Sword Gram.
The Dragon-Cleaving Sword Ridill.
The Dragon-Slaying Sword Arondight.
Swords bearing Stories of dragon slaying.
All of them swords that served as keys to this scenario.
“Go, Yoo Joonghyuk! Free the Apocalypse Dragon!”
“What the fuck are you trying to pull!”
Furious, Han Sooyoung lunged at Yoo Joonghyuk. I threw my whole body into her, wrapped my arms around her, and rolled across the ground. Kicking me, Han Sooyoung shouted.
“You only have four swords! You can’t even clear the scenario!”
“No, there’s one more.”
I pulled a sword from inside my coat.
The Grass Cutting Sword (草薙剣).
It was the sword I had obtained after hunting Yamata no Orochi with Yoo Joonghyuk in [Peace Land].
Since the Grass Cutting Sword had been made from ‘Totsuka-no-tsurugi,’ the sword used to kill Yamata no Orochi, it had inherited the dragon-slaying Story in its entirety.
“Catch, Yoo Joonghyuk!”
Yoo Joonghyuk caught the sword as it shot toward him along [Way of the Wind]. At last, all five swords that had slain dragons were together. Appalled, Han Sooyoung shouted.
“You crazy bastard……!”

Han Sooyoung’s ‘Status’ collided with the ‘Status’ I unleashed. As I activated [Electrification], I sent a torrent of White Pure Star Energy at her. Pushing back the magic power, Han Sooyoung shouted.
“Everyone, grab Yoo Joonghyuk!”
At Han Sooyoung’s words, the companions fighting across the battlefield all turned their eyes toward Yoo Joonghyuk at once.
“I’ll get him!”
Kim Namwoon, the first to spot Yoo Joonghyuk, launched himself at him.
“Damn it, I knew you’d betray us……!”
Lee Jihye and Lee Hyunsung followed a moment later.
No fewer than three of the hundred strongest people in ‘Ways of Survival’ were rushing at Yoo Joonghyuk at once.
Exuding a fearsome aura, Han Sooyoung glared at me and shouted.
“Do you have any idea what you’ve just done? If this scenario is cleared—”
I could barely hear the rest of Han Sooyoung’s words.
I was watching Yoo Joonghyuk’s back as he advanced toward the sealing sphere.
「Kim Dokja thought of the 3rd round’s Yoo Joonghyuk, who would be silently making his way through the scenarios.」
Lee Jihye’s sword slashed Yoo Joonghyuk’s back.
「He thought of the righteous Yoo Sangah, and the clever Han Sooyoung of the 3rd round.」
Lee Hyunsung charged in and caught Yoo Joonghyuk around the waist, while Kim Namwoon activated [Black Flames] and struck him in the face.
「He thought for a long time of the strong Jung Heewon and his children—Lee Gilyoung and Shin Yoosung.」
Yoo Joonghyuk did not retreat. Dressed in his tattered black coat, he pressed forward even as he bled. A sweep of [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] sent Lee Jihye and Lee Hyunsung flying.
「He thought of Lee Jihye, who teased him by calling him ‘trash,’ and Lee Hyunsung, who was forever losing shell casings.」
……I miss them.
「And so, Kim Dokja finally made up his mind.」
I spoke to Han Sooyoung.
“I won’t return to the 3rd round.”
“What nonsense are you spouting? Do you even……”
“I’ll stay here and see the ending with the people of this world.”
The end of this world would not be the ending I wanted.
「It might take a very long time. And perhaps he would never be able to return.」
But even so, if I could somehow just reach the ending.
“‘Secretive Plotter’ isn’t the only Outer God. There must be another way back. If I keep clearing scenarios and moving toward the end……”
“Cut the bullshit! Nothing you do will make any difference! You don’t know the end of this whole story, either!”
“I don’t. And because I don’t.”
Watching Yoo Joonghyuk soar toward the [Sealing Sphere], I continued.
“I’ll make it myself.”

Han Sooyoung leaped into the air and hurled a pitch-black spear at Yoo Joonghyuk. I threw myself into its path and intercepted it for him. The impact left my joints tingling, but I did not back down. Han Sooyoung’s eyes were filled with a murderous intent entirely different from before.
“So you want to do this right now?”
Tzzzzzt!
The Status flowing from Han Sooyoung’s eyes bore down on me head-on.
[The constellation ‘Director of the False Last Act’ looks at you.]
I laughed.
Like me, the Han Sooyoung of this round had no sponsor.
She had become a constellation, just like me.
Whiiiiiine!
She even held the same ‘Unbreakable Faith’ as I did. An Unbreakable Faith upgraded far beyond mine, with pitch-black ether surging around it.
The moment the black energy swept toward me, I unleashed [White Pure Star Energy] and blocked the strike.
Crrrrrack!
Though I had clearly blocked it, the impact left me feeling as if the bones in my hand had been crushed.
Han Sooyoung’s body began to divide.
[Avatar].
Countless copies bearing memories leaped toward Yoo Joonghyuk and me at once.
I moved to stop her.
Jophiel’s 503rd Legion was the perfect answer to copies moving in all directions like that.
“Jophiel!”
But the archangel Jophiel did not answer
I could guess why.
Probably because she didn’t like the choice I had just made.
The archangels would want to return to their original worldline.
But the next moment.
[The Story ‘One Loved by an Archangel’ activates!]
[The constellation ‘Lily Blooming in Aquarius’ bestows her blessing upon you.]
With Gabriel’s indirect message, an archangel’s Status seeped into me.
At the same time, Gabriel’s divine spear, ‘Preference Scale,’ formed in one hand.
[The constellation ‘Lily Blooming in Aquarius’ looks at you.]
[The constellation ‘Commander of the Red Cosmos’ is flustered.]
I didn’t know why Gabriel had chosen to help me.
All I knew for certain was that I desperately needed her help right now.
A charging copy of Han Sooyoung shouted.
“You’re just a reader! Stay out of it! A story belongs to its writer! This world has to end here!”
“This story doesn’t belong to you, either. Make that kind of ending in your own world!”
I swung Preference Scale, cutting down ten or so of Han Sooyoung’s avatars in one go as they soared toward the dark clouds.
Two unbreakable faiths clashed in midair. Holy ether and dark ether tangled together, producing a strange cracking hiss.
Kra-kra-kra-kra-kra-kra-boom!
With a powerful explosion, the lightning of [Electrification] shattered. Covered in wounds, I tumbled across the ground.
Many of Han Sooyoung’s avatars had disappeared, but she was still going strong. As she charged at me through the dust in a fury, I shouted.
“Go! Yoo Joonghyuk!”
Having leaped into the air, Yoo Joonghyuk finally reached the sealing sphere.
[The five keys connect with the sealing sphere.]
Han Sooyoung shouted.
“No!”
The five swords slid into the enormous sealing sphere as keys.
There was a clunk as the locks turned.
[Someone is breaking the ‘Seal of the Apocalypse Dragon.’]
[The scenario’s clear conditions have been fulfilled.]

The power of dragon slaying was awakening the sleeping dragon. The entire sky flickered like a giant light bulb. Night and day each took up half the sky, and I could feel the owner of a tremendous Story awakening—a being I had never seen before.
[All constellations of the nebula ‘Olympus’ are aghast.]
[All constellations of the nebula ‘Vedas’ gasp in horror.]
[All constellations of the nebula ‘Papyrus’ grow wary.]
Amid the nebulas’ messages, the shadow of the dragon trapped inside the hemispherical dome was coming into view.
I knew what would happen next.
Before long, the fully awakened Apocalypse Dragon would roar into the air and lash its tail at the distant constellations of the <Star Stream>. A third of that night sky would vanish.
And perhaps, if I was truly unlucky, I would too—
「Kim Dokja.」

I turned my head. Yoo Joonghyuk stood beside me, holding the [Splitting the Sky Sword]. I had no idea when he had approached. His expression suggested he had no interest whatsoever in clearing this scenario. The moment our eyes met, a chill ran through me.
……When exactly had his ‘Regression Depression’ lifted?
Those two eyes, open and gleaming, regarded me with unmistakable awareness. That awareness was asking me a question.
「Does ‘that world’ you showed me really exist?」
I could find no words to answer Yoo Joonghyuk’s question.
More precisely, for a moment I couldn’t even understand what it meant.
Then I heard his thoughts once more through ‘Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint.’
「Does that ‘world’ you lived in really exist?」
Only then did I realize what Yoo Joonghyuk meant.
He had seen the world I lived in.
「Hee hee」
Inside my head, the ‘Fourth Wall’ gave a mischievous laugh.
Just as I was about to speak, Han Sooyoung rushed up, pressed down on the back of my head, and slammed me into the ground.
“Yoo Joonghyuk! You made me a promise!”
Han Sooyoung’s voice was vicious as she continued.
“You die here, and I get a new world. That was our bargain. Why did you do that!”
With my lips pressed against the ground, I could taste dirt.
「Kim Dokja was thinking about what to do next.」
Again, I didn’t know what Yoo Joonghyuk had felt through my memories.
But judging by his attitude, it seemed he at least wouldn’t give up on this life.
Grrrrrrrr……
A terrible cry came from above the sealing sphere.
[Aaaaaah…….]
[Everyone, run! Hurry, escape this scenario!]
One after another, the horrified constellations were struggling desperately to escape the scenario. Even the nebulas in the sky were massing their Story weapons and pulling back their formations.
That was truly the kind of being the ‘Apocalypse Dragon’ was.
The chief culprit behind <Eden>’s destruction, and the worst calamity in the <Star Stream>.
Amid the pandemonium, Han Sooyoung shouted at Yoo Joonghyuk.
“Is it because of him?”
Grabbing me by the hair, Han Sooyoung kept shouting.
“I’m asking if he did something to your mind. ……Pathetic. Have you started wanting to live now, of all times? You said you were tired! You said you didn’t want to do any more scenarios!”
With every word Han Sooyoung uttered, I felt as if nails were being driven into my own chest. Yoo Joonghyuk’s face showed no emotion, but I knew the life he had lived.
The Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1863rd round was the Yoo Joonghyuk I knew from the original novel.

When my mother was locked up in prison, when I was bullied, when I took the college entrance exam, joined the army, and later got a job at a company. He was the Yoo Joonghyuk I had watched all along. Cold, calculating Yoo Joonghyuk, who never gave up.
From childhood, I had lived my life watching that Yoo Joonghyuk.
Had been able to live.
That was why I didn’t want to let him die.
